data.cultural_impact: The name "Astanah" holds significant cultural importance in Islamic societies, as it is a reminder of the belief in the importance of supporting and aiding one another. In the Islamic tradition, helping and supporting others is considered a noble act and an essential aspect of living a good and righteous life. This name highlights the communal nature of Islamic society and the emphasis on the collective welfare of the community, which is evident in the many social services and charities established in Islamic countries and communities around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Astanah" carries the meaning of being a source of comfort, solace, and refuge for those who are in need. This signifies the concept of Allah (God) being the ultimate source of comfort and support for all believers, especially in times of hardship or distress. This name serves as a reminder of the importance of turning to Allah for strength, guidance, and support, and the belief that Allah is always there to provide aid and assistance to those who seek it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Support" symbolizes She who provides support, aid, and comfort. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Astanah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of support.
